basic_info.description: Welcome to 438 Broderick Street, where period charm meets modern comfort. This beautifully renovated 3BR/2.5BA Edwardian TIC sits in the heart of NOPA. This spacious, light-filled split-level home blends timeless character with modern updates, featuring high ceilings, hardwood floors, crown molding, recessed lighting, and a decorative fireplace. The gourmet kitchen boasts granite counters, a stone backsplash, and stainless steel appliancesincluding a Bertazzoni rangeand flows into a large dining area. The main level also includes two bedrooms, an updated full bath, and a half bath. Downstairs, the expansive media room opens to the shared garden and leads to a stunning primary suite featuring a spacious en suite bathroom with a walk-in shower, tub, double-sink vanity, and private water closet. In-unit laundry and deeded storage add everyday convenience. Located just minutes from USF, Golden Gate Park, tech shuttles, and MUNI, this home offers unparalleled access to city amenities, with a Walk Score of 97 (Walker's Paradise), a Transit Score of 82, and a Bike Score of 89. Enjoy the best of NOPA's vibrant dining, shopping, and cultural sceneright at your doorstep. Schedule a viewing today and experience 438 Broderick Street for yourself!
